verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships an official CLI (glitchtip-cli) with commands for login, creating releases, recording deployments, and uploading debug files/source maps — all standard headless CI automation tasks (e.g. glitchtip-cli releases new 1.0.0 --org --project, glitchtip-cli deploys new). This directly supports scripted/CI use even though it's framed as error-tracking tooling rather than an agent runtime. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI snippets), independent community confirmation of CI usage, and no evidence of a broader headless server/automation mode beyond the CLI.
